import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import glob,json,hashlib,re,subprocess,sys
lane='/home/mj-kang/Documents/Dev/math/openai-proof-research/frontier/campaigns/2026-10-27/new-discoveries-batch2/new-twenty-2026-10-31/expanded-corpus-r532'
root='/home/mj-kang/Documents/Dev/math/openai-proof-research/frontier/campaigns/2026-10-27/new-discoveries-batch2/lanes/pi-mathdb-full-corpus-inventory-r301/corpus/'
ids=json.load(open('reservation.json'))['ids']
want=set(ids)
paths=sorted(glob.glob(root+'mathdb-normalized-chunk-*.jsonl'))
print('chunks',len(paths))
found={}
first=True
for p in paths:
    data=open(p,'rb').read()
    chash=hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
    lines=data.splitlines(keepends=True)
    for i,raw in enumerate(lines,1):
        if not raw.strip(): continue
        o=json.loads(raw)
        mid=o.get('mathdb_id',o.get('id'))
        if first:
            print('KEYS',list(o.keys())); first=False
        if mid in want:
            assert mid not in found
            s=o.get('statement')
            found[mid]=dict(id=mid,chunk=p,chunk_sha256=chash,line_one_based=i,raw_line_sha256_with_newline=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),raw_line_bytes=len(raw),has_trailing_newline=raw.endswith(b'\n'))
            m=re.search(rb'"statement"\s*:\s*("(?:[^"\\]|\\.)*")',raw)
            token=m.group(1)
            assert json.loads(token)==s
            found[mid].update(statement_token_sha256=hashlib.sha256(token).hexdigest(),statement_decoded_sha256=hashlib.sha256(s.encode('utf-8')).hexdigest(),statement_decoded_chars=len(s))
            found[mid]['_rec']={k:o[k] for k in o if k!='statement'}
            found[mid]['_statement']=s
print('found',len(found),'missing',sorted(want-set(found)))
out={'ids':ids,'rows':[{k:v for k,v in found[i].items() if not k.startswith('_')} for i in ids]}
r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',lane+'/write_lane.py','corpus-bindings.json'],input=json.dumps(out,indent=1),text=True,capture_output=True);print(r.returncode,r.stdout,r.stderr)
lits={str(i):dict(meta=found[i]['_rec'],statement=found[i]['_statement']) for i in ids}
r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',lane+'/write_lane.py','literals.json'],input=json.dumps(lits,indent=1,ensure_ascii=False),text=True,capture_output=True);print(r.returncode,r.stdout,r.stderr)
print({i:found[i]['statement_decoded_chars'] for i in ids}); print(sum(found[i]['statement_decoded_chars'] for i in ids))
